why: The words a consultant check is written in: the STATE of <kind>.check.json and of the one document
`coai-mcp --check-consultant` prints, and what became of the CANARY outside the scratch repository.
The server writes them (ConsultCheckStates / CanaryReadings); the panel's Consultant tab words them.
The two halves ship separately, so a word added to one and not the other is a check the other side
Neither half owns this file. The server's test reads its own catalogue by REFLECTION over the public
constants of ConsultCheckStates and CanaryReadings and compares both with these lists; the extension
asserts from its own side that every state here is worded and that its canary wording covers exactly
these readings (the whole-branch review of PLAN_the_consultant_works_on_every_vendor.md, 2026-10-03, J).
`observedConfinement`: only a refusal the CLI recorded against the canary's own path is observed
confinement (cadence consultation 435b1b25). Every other reading must not be worded as if it were.
